description: Devstral Small 2 24B via Ollama: Mistral's agentic coding model (vision, tools); coding-focused, weaker at general reasoning.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull devstral-small-2:24b`. Download 15GB (24B dense, Q4_K_M default tag), needs ~18GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 384K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). Library page claims strong SWE-bench results (number not verified here); coding set 6.0, other axes lower since it is code-specialised. Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Page cites SWE-bench; exact score not extracted. Page checked 2026-10-25.
